Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks again for choosing ON24 for your Nov 12 panel. Quick checklist from my side after the platform prep pass this morning. Please confirm the items below so we can lock the event settings: 

1) Registration gating: we can enable any of the following per the event: 
   - Email domain allowlist (only corporate emails allowed)
   - Manual approval queue (registrations held for review)
   - Invite-only tokenized links (best for sponsor-only sessions)
2) Recording & publishing: options are — do not record, record & send post-event to registrants, or record & publish on-demand on public microsite. We also support automatic transcript generation.
3) Attendee consent: ON24 can add an explicit checkbox on the registration form: "I consent to being recorded and to the replay being shared with registrants and on-demand viewers." (checkbox is optional)
4) EU data residency: if any registrants have EU emails we can pin recording storage to EU data centers — needs 48h advance notice.

Couple of items I need from you:
- Confirm which gating option you want (allowlist / manual queue / token links).
- Confirm recording/publishing preference and whether a consent checkbox is required.
- Any copy for the consent checkbox (legal/marketing to provide).

Attached is a short matrix (on24_gating_options.pdf) that summarizes tradeoffs and queue SLAs.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call this afternoon to finalize.

Best,
Linda Kim
Events Lead, ON24

On gating: we want domain allowlist for the live session (company emails only) and tokenized invite links for the sponsor roundtable (Acme exec-only breakout). Can you set both? We prefer NOT to use manual queues because we don't have headcount to approve thousands.

Recording/publishing: record the session, send post-event recording only to registered attendees; do NOT publish to a public ON24 microsite. For the sponsor roundtable recording, that one should be private and delivered to Acme only.

Consent checkbox: yes — please enable a required checkbox for recording consent on the registration form. Legal will provide language; attaching the addendum we plan to use for retention policy (privacy_addendum_redwood.pdf).

EU residency: we'll likely have a small EU audience; please enable EU storage for recordings and let us know any action items.

Tessa / Marissa —

That draft consent looks fine but two small edits we recommend to reduce scope risk: 
- Change "retain the recording for 12 months" to "retain the recording for up to 12 months" (gives flexibility).
- Add a short line: "Recordings will not be shared with third-party sponsors without explicit consent from speakers."

Final suggested copy below (ready to paste):

I consent to being recorded during this webinar and to receiving the on-demand recording and related materials. I understand Redwood Inference may retain the recording for up to 12 months and will store recordings in the EU for registrants with EU email addresses. Recordings will not be shared with third-party sponsors without explicit consent from speakers. Full details: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink

Approve this and Linda can enable the required checkbox.

— Maya Singh
